title: The Emerald Gala Betrayal
overview_text: The scene is a lavish drawing room in 'Cafe Storage Room'. The victim, 'Marcus Bell', is discovered slumped against a velvet chaise lounge. Cause of death appears to be blunt force trauma inflicted by 'Brass till weight'. 'Priya Shah' was the person who made the grim discovery, and preliminary signs suggest a struggle occurred nearby.
